identity.message: RCO Identity 2.0.6: the saved appearance comes back after a revive (no more missing head), /coat works over MP shirts, and male pieces with no model were removed (Left Ring 5, Wrist Binding 6, MP Accessories 6, 14, 39, 42, 50, 61).

vehicles.message: RCO Vehicles 0.1.108: /carreturn tows your vehicles back to their garages and /givekey <id> [hours] lends your car's key to another player (both can be turned off in the config); the repair kit and the cloth are always taken from the inventory on VORP, also on edited inventories.

gym.message: RCO Gym 0.0.82: the gym on the map (Config.Blip: icon, place, on or off). 0.0.81: first release. A working 1890 gymnasium in Strawberry: 21 exercises on our own equipment, each with its own minigame; strength per muscle group with the muscle on the body (RCO Appearance, RSG Appearance or VORP Character); fatigue, warm-up and strains; wind for stamina and a harder punch; records, the week's champion and a spotter who can save your rep.
